I did not open s144 rows 4-5 or s146 rows 5-9 (from the page images and their overlap with neighbouring rows, I judged them to hold only adirei_ayummah / melekh bemishpat), s152 rows 7-9 (after the qedushah ends) or s154 row 4 (qedushat hayom), so I made no in-scope reading from them.
